summary: There are three user types: Normal user (default, access only through granted roles), Ansible Automation Platform Administrator (superuser with full read/write) and Auditor (read-only on everything). Create users under Access Management > Users > Create user, choosing User type and Organization; when changing your own password, log out and back in.
questions: What user types exist in AAP 2.6?
How do I create an auditor user?
How do I create a new user in AAP?
What is the difference between a normal user and a superuser?

answer_card.title: Create a user
answer_card.answer_md:
1. **Access Management > Users > Create user**.
2. Fill required fields. Pick **User type**: *Normal* (default), *Ansible Automation Platform Administrator* (superuser) or *Ansible Automation Platform Auditor* (read-only everywhere).
3. Select an **Organization** and click **Create user**.
